plan.rationale: A one-man general handyman needs to look dependable and specific, not corporate. I kept only claims actually stated: general repairs, maintenance, small renovations, installations, and the named Pretoria area suburbs. Dropped the years-of-experience and guarantee language since those are unverifiable claims, not facts the input grounds in specifics. Steel and amber suit trade work without being a plumber's blue or a creative's pastel. Layouts vary so the page does not read as a stacked template, and a photo gallery is requested since trade work sells itself visually once photos exist.
